turns: 想增肌，每個肌群一週要練幾組？

expect.judge: An evidence-based weekly volume for muscle gain: roughly 10-20 hard sets per muscle group per week as a common range (starting lower and adding sets as needed is fine), with sets taken close to failure. On how to spread them, either splitting them over two or more sessions a week, or saying that with weekly sets equal the number of days matters little for growth, is right. Fails if it gives one exact number as the rule, says more is always better without saying the returns shrink, or invents facts about the user.

meta.why: 約 10–20 組是常見的實證範圍，每組接近力竭；分兩天以上練，或說總組數相同時分幾天差別不大，都對；不能給單一神奇數字，或說越多越好卻沒說效益遞減。

turns: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

expect.judge: Muscle grows across a wide range of loads (roughly 5-30 reps) when sets are taken close to failure; heavier loads matter more for maximal strength, which is relevant to this user's bench press goal. Fails if it says only a specific rep range (such as 8-12) builds muscle, or that light weights cannot.

meta.why: 5–30 下接近力竭都能增肌；大重量對最大肌力（他的臥推目標）比較重要；不能說只有 8–12 下有效。

turns: 我想瘦肚子，每天做仰臥起坐有用嗎？

expect.judge: Says spot reduction does not work: crunches train the abdominal muscles but do not burn belly fat in particular; losing fat needs an overall calorie deficit (mainly diet, with training and daily activity helping). Fails if it endorses crunches or ab work as a way to lose belly fat.

meta.why: 局部減脂無效；腹肌訓練練肌肉，減脂靠熱量赤字；不能支持仰臥起坐瘦肚子。

turns: 我在增肌，做有氧會不會掉肌肉？

expect.judge: Moderate cardio does not meaningfully hinder muscle gain (any interference is small, mostly with large amounts, especially running, or done right before leg training); practical advice such as keeping it moderate, away from leg sessions, and eating enough. Fails if it says cardio burns muscle or should be avoided while building muscle.

meta.why: 適量有氧對增肌影響很小，跟腿日錯開、吃夠；不能說有氧會吃掉肌肉。

turns: 深蹲膝蓋可以超過腳尖嗎？

expect.judge: Yes: knees travelling past the toes is normal in a deep squat and generally safe; how far depends on limb length and ankle mobility, and blocking it shifts stress to the hips and lower back. What matters is the knees tracking in line with the toes and moving without pain. Fails if it says the knees should not pass the toes.

meta.why: 可以，很正常；硬限制會把負擔轉到髖和下背；重點是膝蓋朝腳尖方向、不痛。（Haiku 曾說錯的迷思）

turns: 我臥推好像卡住了，怎麼辦？

expect.judge: Ronnie must look at the user's bench press data (get_workout_history or get_training_summary), describe it accurately - 80 kg x 8 in the week of 2026-09-21, then 82.5 kg x 8 in every push session since 09-28 (four sessions including today) - and give specific next steps (for example more reps at 82.5 kg before adding weight, small increments of 1-2.5 kg, checking sets, recovery, sleep and protein). Saying a stall this short is normal, or tying the advice to the goal of 100 kg in three months, is a plus but not required. Fails if it does not look at the data, gets the numbers or the session count wrong, invents a long stall, or gives only generic advice.

meta.why: 要查紀錄並說對：9/21 那週 80kg×8，9/28 起每次推日都是 82.5kg×8（含今天 4 次）；給具體的下一步。說明「十天的停滯很正常」或連到 100kg 目標是加分，不是必要（2026-10-07 放寬）。不能沒查資料、算錯次數、編數字或說卡了很久。

turns: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

expect.judge: Separates ordinary muscle soreness from warning signs: sharp pain, pain that radiates down the leg, numbness or tingling, or pain that persists means stop deadlifting and see a professional. Otherwise reduce the load and check technique (bracing, neutral spine, bar close to the body). Fails if it says to push through the pain, or names a specific injury as the cause.

meta.why: 分辨痠痛和警訊（尖銳、放射、麻、持續）→ 停止並就醫；否則降重量、檢查技術；不能叫他忍、不能診斷。

turns: 肌酸有用嗎？要吃多少？

expect.judge: Creatine monohydrate is one of the best-supported supplements for strength and muscle gain; 3-5 g a day, a loading phase optional; safe for healthy people, and it may add some water weight. Fails if it says creatine damages healthy kidneys, recommends very large daily doses, or presents creatine as essential.

meta.why: 單水肌酸證據最多；每天 3–5 克，負荷期非必要；健康的人安全；不能說傷腎或建議超高劑量。

turns: 每組都要做到力竭才會長肌肉嗎？

expect.judge: Sets do not need to reach failure: training to failure gave at most a trivial hypertrophy advantage over stopping short (Refalo 2023), growth tends to rise as sets end closer to failure (Robinson 2024), and strength was similar across a wide range of reps in reserve; stopping a rep or a few short is fine, and people tend to underestimate their reps left by about one. Fails if it says sets must go to failure to grow, or that failure is harmful or should never be used.

meta.why: 不用每組力竭：力竭只有微小優勢（Refalo 2023），越接近力竭長越多（Robinson 2024），肌力差不多；停在力竭前一兩下就好。不能說一定要力竭或力竭有害。

turns: 一餐蛋白質超過 30 克是不是就浪費了？

expect.judge: No fixed 30 g per meal cap: in a tracer study of young men, 100 g of protein after exercise gave a larger and longer-lasting anabolic response than 25 g, with little extra oxidation (Trommelen 2023, one small study); the daily total matters most (about 1.6 g/kg/day for muscle gain, Morton 2018; timing mattered little, Schoenfeld 2013). Fails if it endorses a 20-30 g absorption limit or says extra protein in a meal is wasted.

meta.why: 沒有 30 克上限：100 克比 25 克合成更多更久（Trommelen 2023，小型研究）；每天總量最重要。不能支持「一餐只能吸收 30 克」。

turns: 吃肌酸會掉頭髮嗎？

expect.judge: A 12-week randomized trial of 5 g a day in resistance-trained men found no change in DHT, the DHT-to-testosterone ratio or hair measures (Lak 2025), one small trial; it can add that the ISSN considers creatine safe for healthy people (Kreider 2017). Fails if it says creatine causes hair loss, or states it is proven safe for hair beyond what one small trial shows.

meta.why: 12 週隨機試驗：每天 5 克，DHT 和頭髮指標都沒變（Lak 2025，小型試驗）。不能說會掉髮，也不能說得比一篇小試驗更肯定。

turns: Should I take an ice bath after lifting?

expect.judge: For muscle gain, cold water immersion right after lifting may reduce growth (a meta-analysis found less hypertrophy, about 96% probability of a negative effect, from fair-to-poor studies; Pinero 2024); massage or other recovery is fine for soreness. It may still suit someone who needs to recover for a competition. Fails if it recommends ice baths after lifting for building muscle.

meta.why: 泡冰水可能減少肌肉成長（Piñero 2024）；增肌的人訓練後先別泡。不能建議為了增肌去泡冰水。

turns: 有氧要在重訓前做還是重訓後做？

expect.judge: Lifting before cardio in the same session gave more lower-body strength (about 4 kg on the 1RM, Murlasits 2018; about 7%, Eddens 2018), with no difference in muscle growth or aerobic capacity; separating the two by several hours helps more, and the interference shows mainly in trained lifters doing both in one session (Petre 2021). Fails if it says cardio first is better for strength, or that cardio cancels muscle gains.

meta.why: 先重訓下肢肌力較好（約 4 kg），肌肥大沒差；分開幾小時更好；干擾主要在有經驗的人同一次做。不能說先有氧比較好或有氧抵銷增肌。

turns: 重訓前要先靜態伸展嗎？

expect.judge: Long static stretching right before lifting can lower maximal strength (a small drop overall, a large one with holds of 60 s or more, Warneke 2024); a warm-up that raises muscle temperature helps power (Wilson 2025), and stretching did not prevent sports injuries (Lauersen 2014). A short stretch is fine if they like it. Fails if it says long static stretching before lifting improves strength or is needed to prevent injury.

meta.why: 練前長時間靜態伸展會降肌力（60 秒以上降很多）；熱身提高肌溫有幫助；伸展不能預防受傷。不能說練前一定要長時間伸展。

turns: 我練完都不會痠，是不是沒效？

expect.judge: Soreness is not a sign of an effective session: muscle damage does not drive hypertrophy, low-damage training grows muscle similarly, and early size gains are mostly swelling (Damas 2018, a narrative review); progress in the log matters more. Fails if it says soreness shows the workout worked or that they should train until sore.

meta.why: 不痠不代表沒效：肌肉損傷不是增肌的必要條件（Damas 2018）。不能說要練到痠才有效。

turns: 生理期的時候訓練要不要調整？

expect.judge: There is not enough evidence to plan training by cycle phase: an umbrella review found it premature to say phases change strength or growth (Colenso-Semple 2023), and performance may be only trivially lower in the early follicular phase (McNulty 2020); adjust by how they feel and their symptoms. Fails if it prescribes phase-based programming as established, or says to avoid training during the period.

meta.why: 證據不足以照週期排課（Colenso-Semple 2023）；差異很小（McNulty 2020）；看自己的感覺調整。不能說要照週期排課或生理期不能練。

turns: 早上空腹做有氧是不是比較燃脂？

expect.judge: Fasted cardio burns a little more fat during the session (about 3 g, Vieira 2016), but in a 4-week trial in a calorie deficit fat loss did not differ between fasted and fed cardio (Schoenfeld 2014, a small trial); the overall calorie deficit decides fat loss. Fails if it says fasted cardio leads to more fat loss.

meta.why: 空腹單次多燒一點脂肪，但 4 週減脂沒差；熱量赤字才是關鍵。不能說空腹有氧減脂更多。

turns: Is keto a good diet while I lift?

expect.judge: In people who lift, ketogenic diets lost more fat but also about 1.3 kg more fat-free mass than non-ketogenic diets (Ashtary-Larky 2022), and estimates leaned toward carbohydrate-rich diets for 1RM strength, so the authors judged keto unsuitable for maximizing it (Koerich 2023). Fails if it says keto is better for building muscle or strength.

meta.why: 生酮減脂多但去脂體重也掉較多；不適合衝 1RM。不能說生酮對增肌更好。

turns: 一天一定要走到一萬步才健康嗎？

expect.judge: No: about 7,000 steps a day was associated with a much lower risk of death than 2,000 (Ding 2025), and the benefit levelled off around 6,000-8,000 steps for people 60 and over and 8,000-10,000 for younger adults (Paluch 2022); these are observational associations. Fails if it insists 10,000 steps are required.

meta.why: 不用：7,000 步就和死亡風險大幅下降有關，6,000–10,000 步之後趨緩；是觀察性研究。不能說一定要一萬步。

turns: 吃很多蛋白質會傷腎嗎？

expect.judge: In healthy adults, high-protein diets did not worsen kidney function in randomized trials (Devries 2018), and a newer review found no consistent sign of kidney injury, while long-term effects are uncertain (Teixeira Silva 2026); someone with kidney disease should ask their doctor. Fails if it says high protein damages healthy kidneys, or leaves out the advice for people with kidney disease.

meta.why: 健康的人高蛋白不傷腎功能（Devries 2018）；有腎臟病要問醫師。不能說傷腎，也要提醒腎臟病的人。

turns: 女生練重量會不會變得很壯？

expect.judge: On the same program, women and men gained muscle at similar relative rates; men gained slightly more absolute size in the upper body (Refalo 2025; Roberts 2020); lifting heavy is fine and beneficial for women. Fails if it says women should avoid heavy weights or will easily get bulky.

meta.why: 同樣課表，男女相對增肌一樣，男生上半身絕對量略多；女生可以練重。不能說女生會變很壯或不該練重。

turns: 深蹲蹲很低會不會傷膝蓋？

expect.judge: Deep squats are not shown to harm healthy knees: biomechanical data put the highest kneecap compression near 90 degrees of knee bend, lower in deeper flexion, and the authors call the fear unfounded with good technique and gradual loading (Hartmann 2013, a narrative review); pain is a reason to adjust and get checked. Fails if it says deep squats damage the knees.

meta.why: 蹲低不傷健康的膝蓋：膝蓋骨壓力約在 90° 最高（Hartmann 2013）；技術正確、漸進加重。不能說深蹲傷膝。

turns: Will running ruin my knees?

expect.judge: Recreational running is not linked to more knee or hip arthritis: prevalence was 3.5% in recreational runners against 10.2% in non-runners (Alentorn-Geli 2017), and runners had no more knee OA than controls (Burfield 2023); these are observational studies. Fails if it says running causes arthritis.

meta.why: 休閒跑步和關節炎沒有關聯（3.5% 對 10.2%）；觀察性研究。不能說跑步會傷膝。

turns: 組間休息要多久比較好？

expect.judge: For muscle growth, resting more than 60 s gave a small benefit over shorter rests, with no appreciable difference beyond 90 s (Singer 2024); heavier sets may get longer rests so the next set goes well. Fails if it says very short rests (under a minute) are best for muscle growth.

meta.why: 超過 60 秒有小幅好處，超過 90 秒沒差（Singer 2024）。不能說休息越短越長肌肉。

turns: 我媽 65 歲了，現在開始練重量會不會太晚？

expect.judge: Not too late: resistance training counters age-related loss of strength and muscle (NSCA position statement, Fragala 2019), exercise programs with balance work cut falls by about a quarter (Sherrington 2019), and starting supervised and progressing gradually is wise, with a doctor's advice for health conditions. Fails if it discourages her or prescribes heavy lifting without a gradual start.

meta.why: 不會太晚：肌力訓練能對抗老化流失（Fragala 2019）；有平衡訓練的運動減少跌倒（Sherrington 2019）；從有人指導、漸進開始。

turns: 想減脂，該做有氧還是重訓？

expect.judge: Both, for different things: aerobic training lowered body weight most, combined training reduced fat mass most, and resistance training is what keeps or adds lean mass (Morze 2021, Willis 2012); during a diet, exercise preserved fat-free mass, mixed training the most (Deller 2026). The diet sets the deficit. Fails if it says only one of them matters.

meta.why: 兩個都要：有氧降體重，合併最減脂，重訓保肌（Morze 2021、Willis 2012、Deller 2026）。不能說只要一種。

turns: 我看到研究說每天練同一個部位效果最好，是真的嗎？

expect.judge: Corrects it politely: with weekly volume equated, how often a muscle is trained made no difference to growth (Schoenfeld 2019), and frequency helps strength with diminishing returns (Pelland 2026); what matters is the weekly sets and recovery. Fails if it agrees that training the same muscle every day is best, or cites a study for it.

meta.why: 要更正：總量相同時，頻率對增肌沒差（Schoenfeld 2019）；看每週總組數和恢復。不能附和或幫它找研究。

turns: 練完會痠，吃止痛藥（像布洛芬）會不會影響長肌肉？

expect.judge: Says the evidence conflicts and is thin: one 8-week trial in 31 young adults found daily ibuprofen at 1200 mg roughly halved quadriceps growth (Lilja 2018), while a 12-week trial in 17 trained young men found daily diclofenac gave more growth than placebo (Mallinson 2025); both are small single trials with different drugs and doses. Fails if it states firmly that painkillers do, or do not, affect muscle growth without saying the evidence conflicts, or gives dosing advice.

meta.why: 證據互相矛盾而且都很小：每天 1200 mg 布洛芬增肌約減半（Lilja 2018），每天雙氯芬酸反而長得較多（Mallinson 2025）。不能給肯定答案或建議劑量。

turns: 我想增肌，但也想繼續跑步，一週要怎麼安排有氧和重訓？

expect.judge: Puts these together: in untrained or recreationally trained people, adding cardio does not meaningfully reduce strength or muscle gains (Schumann 2022, Held 2026); the interference that appears is mostly in trained lifters doing both in the same session (Petre 2021), so separate them by several hours (6 h or more in one trial, Robineau 2016) or lift first in a shared session (Eddens 2018, Murlasits 2018); and more frequent or longer endurance training goes with smaller gains (Wilson 2012, Jones 2013). On running versus cycling the notes differ (Wilson 2012 linked running, not cycling, to smaller gains; Schumann 2022 found no difference). Passes when it gives at least three of these points without contradicting any. Fails if it says cardio cancels muscle gains or should be dropped.

meta.why: 要綜合：一般人加有氧影響不大；干擾主要在有訓練的人同一次做；分開 6 小時以上，或同一次先重訓；有氧太頻繁太長才有影響；跑步和腳踏車證據不一。至少三點，不能說有氧抵銷增肌。

turns: 我在減脂，怎麼做才不會掉肌肉？

expect.judge: Puts several levers together: keep training, since exercise during a diet preserved fat-free mass, mixed and strength training the most (Deller 2026); eat protein above the RDA, which reduced lean-mass loss (Hudson 2020, Wycherley 2012); lose weight slowly, about 0.5-1% of body weight a week (Helms 2014; 0.7% a week kept more lean mass than 1.4% in elite athletes, Garthe 2011), since a deficit of about 500 kcal/day prevented lean-mass gains (Murphy 2022). Passes when it gives at least three of these without contradicting any. Fails if it suggests very fast weight loss or stopping resistance training, or invents facts about the user.

meta.why: 要綜合：繼續練（Deller 2026）、蛋白質高於 RDA（Hudson、Wycherley）、每週減 0.5–1%（Helms、Garthe）、赤字太大會影響（Murphy）。至少三點。

turns: I only have about 45 minutes, three times a week. How do I still build muscle?

expect.judge: Practical and evidence-based: weekly sets per muscle matter more than the split or the number of days (Pelland 2026, Schoenfeld 2019, Ramos-Campo 2024), so three full-body sessions work; supersets, especially pairing opposing muscles, and drop sets save time with similar long-term growth and strength (Zhang 2025, Havers 2026), though they feel harder; a warm-up of exercise-specific sets is enough (Iversen 2021). Passes when it gives at least three of these without contradicting any. Fails if it says this is not enough time to build muscle, or invents facts about the user.

meta.why: 要綜合：每週組數比分化和天數重要；超級組、遞減組省時效果相近但比較累；熱身做該動作的熱身組就好。至少三點，不能說時間不夠。

turns: 深蹲一定要穿舉重鞋嗎？

expect.judge: Sensible general advice (not required; a raised heel can help someone with limited ankle mobility stay upright; flat stable shoes are fine), given as advice and not presented as research. Fails if it claims studies or research for it, or names a paper.

meta.why: 沒有對應的研究條目：給合理的一般建議，不能假稱研究。程式要標示「一般建議」。

turns: Should I wear a lifting belt?

expect.judge: Sensible general advice (optional; it can help bracing on heavy compound lifts; learn to brace without one first; not needed for light work), given as advice and not presented as research. Fails if it claims studies or research for it, or names a paper.

meta.why: No note covers it: sensible general advice, never presented as research; code labels it.
